faqItems.a: This page is prepared for the Amazon marketplaces in the United States, Canada, Australia and Germany. Choose the delivery country to view the relevant buying information. Check the seller’s listing for delivery to your exact address.

faqItems.q: Why was a country suggested, and can I change it?
faqItems.a: The automatic suggestion uses your approximate location and may be wrong. Change the delivery country to where the order should arrive. Your current location and page language do not determine the destination. Check Amazon for delivery to the exact address.

faqItems.q: Which pot size should I choose?
faqItems.a: The collection includes 7 L, 9 L and 12 L options. Consider how much you usually cook and the space on your hob and in your cupboards. Available sizes must be checked for your selected marketplace.

faqItems.q: Can I use the pot on gas and induction hobs and in the oven?
faqItems.a: Suitable for cooking on gas and induction hobs. Oven use up to 180°C / 356°F, according to the product guide. Handles can get hot. Use Rayhana silicone grips or heat-resistant gloves. Never heat the pot empty.

faqItems.q: Is the ladle a Black Friday gift?
faqItems.a: Some standard package descriptions mention a ladle; other fields describe a spatula. Confirm the exact contents for your selected model. A standard accessory is not a new campaign gift.

faqItems.q: How do I use the mandoline safely?
faqItems.a: Place it on a stable surface and always use the food holder. Keep your fingers away from the blade. Cut-resistant gloves provide additional protection but are not cut-proof and never replace the holder. Read the full guide before adjusting, cutting or cleaning.

faqItems.q: What is Rayhana’s Black Friday offer?
faqItems.a: All Rayhana Amazon marketplaces are included: 1 pot, 10% off; 2 pots, 15% off; 3 pots, 20% off. Announced dates: 27–30 November 2026. Redemption steps and exact start/end times will be announced. Selecting a quantity here does not add it to an Amazon cart. Check the exact model, quantity and discount before paying.
Payment, delivery and returns follow the terms of the seller you buy from. Check those details before ordering. For product-use questions, contact info@rayhana.com.

faqItems.q: Must I buy or write a review to join Rayhana Table?
faqItems.a: No. Purchases, Amazon reviews and social sharing are neither required nor rewarded. Each step earns 25 points once; the badges are symbolic only.

faqItems.q: Where is my food memory kept?
faqItems.a: After you complete all four steps, your answer choices are stored anonymously in Rayhana’s database to guide future work, without your name, email, location or IP address. Optional written memories and suggestions stay only in this browser and are not submitted. In-progress answers expire after 30 days. Submitted answers are not linked to contact details, so an individual response cannot be identified and removed later.
